name: Asagiri Yuumi
source:
A former 'Tenshi' who lived in Akatsuki and died in the line of duty.
He was [url=/c41639]Izuki's[/url] senior and they teamed up on many missions together.
Even though he is no longer in this world anymore he has an unexpected influence on the story.
